recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not restore STU3 choice/open-choice wording; any future change to the coding/string/uri answerValueSet design should be handled by a new work-group issue.
issue_request: FHIR-18872 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for FHIR-core Questionnaire. It reported that Questionnaire.item.answerValueSet allowed choice and open-choice questions while the que-5 human description said only choice items could have answerValueSet; the final requirement was to make the human rule text reflect the executable constraint.
initial_application: Commit cbff33df9bd5be63e2896db96ebd360f26730d2d applied the issue to the old Questionnaire spreadsheet source by changing que-5 from choice-only to choice/open-choice wording. That source has since been replaced by current StructureDefinition source and later Questionnaire design changes.

Later Applied FHIR-40780 split answerValueSet into que-5b with coding/string/uri scope and corrected the current answerValueSet invariant prose. Both related issues already have reconciliation commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml has que-5 for answerOption, que-5b for answerValueSet, and answerValueSet references que-5b; the human text and FHIRPath expressions are aligned with the current model.
